t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Pick a category of colours and stick to it. Once it starts to produce fewer mushrooms, then I should swap over to the other set of colours.

vb_textbox.text: In the game, the gnomes are divided into 2 categories. Red based colours (RED/PINK/PURPLE/BROWN) and Yellow/Blue based colours (YELLOW/GREEN/BLUE/ORANGE). Be sure to memorise one of these sets. In the forest, there will either be a red or yellow basket. One tip for remembering the sets is by selecting one and sticking to it while the mushroom count is plentiful. The amount of mushrooms you'll collect in each round will vary (the highest I found was 45). There's no need to change if you get more than 4 or 5 mushrooms. If you start getting any number of mushrooms from 0 - 2, try swapping over to the other set of colours. Good luck and have fun!
